title: The Trinity
definition: The Trinity means that there is one God who eternally exists as three distinct Persons: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
summary: Christians worship one God, not three gods. Yet Scripture reveals the Father as God, the Son as God, and the Holy Spirit as God. Each Person is distinct, and each is fully divine.
christFocus: Jesus is not merely a messenger from God. He is the eternal Son of God who reveals the Father, accomplishes redemption, and sends the Spirit to dwell with His people.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God is one in being and three in Person. The Trinity is a mystery revealed by Scripture, not a human invention or mathematical puzzle.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: The Gospel depends on the Trinity: the Father sends, the Son redeems, and the Spirit applies salvation. Christian worship, prayer, and discipleship are deeply Trinitarian.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Worship the Father, trust the Son, and walk by the Spirit. Let the triune work of God shape your prayer, confidence, salvation, and obedience.
